blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: North Meadows' only attached pocket is Meadow Gardens Way, beside Meadow Gardens Golf Course, north of Lougheed Highway (Highway 7).

North Meadows is a board sub-area name for Pitt Meadows north of Lougheed Highway, covering Highland Park, Wildwood, Harris Road north and the rural Pitt Polder farm roads beyond; the City publishes no boundary for the name.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The Fairways at 19673 and 19677 Meadow Gardens Way is the one condo complex here, described by its developer Magusta Development as 268 resort-style homes around a courtyard with a Residents' Club overlooking the golf course.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: Long-term rental caps in strata bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022, and Pitt Meadows separately prohibits short-term rental accommodation under Zoning Bylaw No. 2505, 2011.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road stands inside this sub-area even though the Advent Road strata pocket beside it is filed under Central Meadows.
The North Lougheed Connector, a proposed two-kilometre link from Abernethy Way to Lougheed Highway, is planned to change traffic on Old Dewdney Trunk Road north of here.
Pitt Lake cabin lots labelled North Meadows in feeds are boat-access only and are not serviced strata homes.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: 3047, 2026, including the separate drainage rate.
The Speculation and Vacancy Tax applies in Pitt Meadows, so a Fairways owner places the same annual declaration as any other owner in the city.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Lougheed Highway (Highway 7) is the sub-area's south edge and its only arterial; Meadow Gardens Way is a local road off it.

blocks.text: North Meadows Condos and Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the lot against Floodplain Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 Schedules A and B before assuming the golf-course pocket and the Pitt Polder farm roads carry the same flood level — the bylaw sets different designated levels for its rural and urban schedules. Designation and Construction Control Bylaw No. 2384, 2008 - Consolidated.pdf
Richardson Road and Hale Road acreages sit in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR); a condo buyer at The Fairways is urban, but any North Meadows land purchase needs an ALR check on the City OCP maps.
Building within seven metres of a dike toe needs a permit under Drainage Bylaw No. 2266, 2007 — relevant to Polder lots, not to a Fairways strata lot.

blocks.text: Jared's take on North Meadows

North of Lougheed Highway, Pitt Meadows splits two ways. The Highland Park and Wildwood streets near Harris Road are residential, and beyond them the rural Pitt Polder farmland and its dikes stretch toward Pitt Lake.

faq.a: The Greater Vancouver REALTORS® counted 7 condos and townhomes listed in North Meadows at the end of October 2026. The number changes daily, so ask Jared for today’s count.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in North Meadows?

faq.a: In October 2026, condos and townhomes in North Meadows had a sales ratio of 29% on only 7 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is North Meadows a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?

faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 6 condos and townhomes sold in North Meadows; Pitt Meadows as a whole recorded 77.
faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in North Meadows from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?

faq.a: The developer describes 268 resort-style homes with a Residents' Club, exercise facilities and a games room, and earlier listing records show family amenities. Only the registered bylaws attached to the Form B settle the age question for a specific purchase.

None that I know of on a developer or strata source, so a townhome search for this sub-area will mostly return detached houses and farm properties. The one attached address buyers actually tour is The Fairways on Meadow Gardens Way, which is apartment-condo form.
faq.q: Are there townhomes to buy in North Meadows?

faq.a: Highland Park Elementary at 18961 Advent Road is the Pitt Meadows elementary school on the north side, listed for School District 42 at kindergarten to grade 7, and all Pitt Meadows addresses feed Pitt Meadows Secondary at 19438 116B Avenue for grades 8 to 12. Catchments in this district are address-based, so run the exact Meadow Gardens Way address in the district locator rather than assuming the nearest school building is the catchment school.
faq.q: Which school serves Meadow Gardens Way?

faq.a: The Fairways was built as a golf-course-edge complex, with its Residents' Club overlooking Meadow Gardens Golf Course according to the developer. That setting is the product: courtyard homes oriented to the course rather than to a town centre.
